title: The Wave to the Ferry
youtube_title: The Wave to the Ferry | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Kei feels shy about a wave big enough for the ferry to notice, or not. Instead of pretending not to care, Kei tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
